title: ADR missing the kind discriminator
context: An ADR that omits the required kind field.
decision: Test that a missing kind is rejected.
consequences: The artefact cannot be recognised as an ADR.
invariants: kind must be present and equal to adr.
forbiddenDrift: Do not omit the kind discriminator.
aiAlignmentRules: Stop if the artefact kind is unknown.
permittedChanges: The kind discriminator may be corrected by a recorded decision.
description: Defect: required property kind is missing.
aiGuidance: This instance must be rejected because kind is missing.
